articles.title: Hunter Biden's new LAPTOP token lost 98% of its value in under an hour after $1.6 billion debut
articles.snippet: LAPTOP swung from $190 to under $4 within minutes of opening on Base. Onchain records show tokens had been distributed to market makers for a week before trading began.

articles.title: Hunter Biden defends LAPTOP ahead of Wednesday launch, calls TRUMP a ‘grift’
articles.snippet: Biden says the token is about “resilience, redemption and recovery” and will give coins to nearly one million wallets that lost money on TRUMP.

articles.title: Hunter Biden’s laptop controversy gets a memecoin afterlife
articles.snippet: The project’s disclosures say LAPTOP has no utility, lock founder tokens for six months and reserve 2% for wallets that lost money on TRUMP.

articles.title: What Is LAPTOP? Hunter Biden's Meme Coin Targeting TRUMP Holders
articles.snippet: The LAPTOP token launched on Base in September 2026, peaked two minutes later, and shed almost all of its value the same day.

articles.title: Hunter Biden's LAPTOP Meme Coin Crashes 99% on Debut
articles.snippet: LAPTOP hit a $190.81 peak within minutes of launching on Base, then shed roughly 99% as thin liquidity met a wave of selling.
